raw.text: Your goblet squat plan is 3 sets of 8 to 12 reps, stopping with about 2 reps left in the tank and resting 90 seconds between sets. When you can do all 3 sets of 12 with good form and still have about 2 reps to spare, that's your signal to go a little heavier next time. With the heavier weight you'll probably drop back toward 8 reps, and then you can build back up to 12. The progression card below explains why this gradual approach works.
